description: Vanilla Enchanted – pure Minecraft with a touch of magic
body:
# Vanilla Enchanted

**Vanilla Enchanted – pure Minecraft with a touch of magic**  

This modpack keeps the classic **Minecraft 1.20.6** experience while adding only the most useful and immersive mods. Enhanced F3, beautiful lighting, dynamic sounds, an intuitive interface, and FPS optimization make the game smooth, while visual and animation mods bring a little magic to the world.  

Perfect for players who want to stay close to vanilla but enjoy subtle improvements that make every day in Minecraft more enjoyable.  

## Features
- **Performance & FPS optimization:** Lithium, FpsReducer, EntityCulling  
- **Visual enhancements:** Iris, Sodium, SubtleEffects, AmbientSounds, Particle Mods  
- **UI & convenience:** BetterF3, Jade, InventoryProfilesNext, HeldItemInfo  
- **Animations & atmosphere:** NotEnoughAnimations, PresenceFootsteps, Dynamic Lights  
- **Compatibility:** fully compatible with the latest Fabric and mods  

**Vanilla Enchanted** – for those who love vanilla Minecraft but want it prettier and smoother.
